description: A 'Printed' date under the due-date section is a print/issue date, not a response deadline. Must not invent 'Respond by'.

input.text:
MAPLE COUNTY BENEFITS OFFICE
It is time to renew your benefits.
The benefits you need to renew have a check-mark next to them:
[x] SNAP
Due dates:
Send your renewal as soon as you can. If we don't get it in time, your benefits might end.
Printed 10/01/2026
Items we need from you: send copies.
• Proof of income: last 4 pay stubs.
